nativeSvmWorldDerivations.description: Selected native typed SVM world interpreter in WGSL; existing source repository, no new external dependency. Inverse-trigonometric adapters are original CodeBrix mathematical implementations.

nativeShaderDataDerivations.description: Static triangle shader-data setup, transforms, packed normals and compact differentials; original CPU shader_setup_from_ray supplies the oracle. Existing pinned source, no new external dependency. Portable buffer replay checks the GPU kernel only.
